g.text: Where the drawings and current boundaries agree
Six examples from the 1997/98 administrative maps, aligned to current BC reference geometry.
Percentages are drawing intersection-over-union, not legal verification or registration accuracy. Scale varies by area.
Close broad-scale fit · current LHA combination
Three modern LHAs closely follow the source drawing.
Close broad-scale fit · current LHA combination
A predefined LHA combination is a useful working proxy.
Boundary School District 51 closely resembles the drawing.
Quesnel School District 28 helps check the council edges.

Original registration; working view adjusts north · current LHA combination
The app applies a separate provisional 5 km north adjustment.
Three physical controls per main map. Insets remain unregistered. Source traces show approximate land display, not marine jurisdiction.
Original Ministry maps: BC Auditor General, March 1998. Current BC data: Open Government Licence – British Columbia.
The downloadable comparison viewer includes all 52 labels, six current boundary types, definitions and explicit estimate choices.
